items.title: 29.5.2 Important (ahem) functional groups ke IR spectra (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the IR spectra of functional groups (PDF 193-195).

blocks.text: Alcohol ka OH group 3600-3200 cm⁻¹ par strong (tez) absorption deta hai. 3000 cm⁻¹ wali peak sp³ hybridized C−H bonds ki wajah se hai.

blocks.alt: 2-Butanol, CH3CH(OH)CH2CH3, ka IR spectrum: % transmittance (0 se 100) aur wavenumber/cm^-1 (4000 se 400). 3350 ke qareeb bohat broad (chaura), deep (gehra) band O-H ke naam se marked hai; 2950 ke qareeb sharp C-H bands aur 1500 se neeche bohat se bands.
blocks.caption: 2-Butanol ka IR spectrum (29.5.2 mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: Amine ka N−H bond 3300 aur 3400 cm⁻¹ par do weak (kamzor) absorptions deta hai.

blocks.alt: Octylamine, CH3(CH2)7NH2, ka IR spectrum: % transmittance aur wavenumber/cm^-1 (4000 se 400). 3370 aur 3290 ke qareeb do chhote, weak dips (jhukao) N-H ke naam se marked; 2900 ke qareeb bohat strong C-H bands aur 1600, 1470 aur 800 ke qareeb aur bands.
blocks.caption: Octylamine ka IR spectrum (29.5.2 mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: Amide 1500 cm⁻¹ se oopar apne N−H aur C=O dono groups ki absorptions dikhata hai: N−H (do peaks) 3200 aur 3400 cm⁻¹ par, aur C=O 1660 cm⁻¹ par.

blocks.alt: Propanamide, CH3CH2CONH2, ka IR spectrum: % transmittance aur wavenumber/cm^-1 (4000 se 400). 3350 aur 3180 ke qareeb do strong dips N-H ke naam se, aur 1650 ke qareeb bohat strong band C=O ke naam se marked; 1450 aur 1100 ke darmiyan aur sharp bands.
blocks.caption: Propanamide ka IR spectrum (29.5.2 mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: Carboxylic acids ka C=O group 1700 cm⁻¹ par strong absorption deta hai, aur saath hi acid ke O-H bond ki 2500 se 3300 cm⁻¹ ke darmiyan broad (chauri) aur deep (gehri) absorption hoti hai. Is broad peak ka daen (right) hissa aksar C-H bonds ki peaks ki wajah se distorted (bigra hua) nazar aata hai.

blocks.alt: Carboxylic acid ka IR spectrum: absorbance / % (oopar 0, neeche 100) aur wavenumber/cm^-1 (4000 se 500). Taqreeban 3700 se 2500 tak bohat broad (chaura), deep band, 3100 ke qareeb sab se gehra, jis ke daen hisse par chhote C-H bumps (ubhaar) hain; 1750 ke qareeb bohat strong band aur 1450 aur 600 ke darmiyan kai strong bands.
blocks.caption: Carboxylic acid ka IR spectrum (29.5.2 mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is spectrum mein absorbance neeche ki taraf barhti hai. 3700 se 2500 tak ka bohat broad, gehra band acid ka O-H hai, aur us ke daen kinare par chhote C-H ubhaar hain. 1750 ke qareeb ka strong, sharp band C=O hai. Broad O-H + C=O dono saath hon to compound carboxylic acid hai.

blocks.title: NOTE
blocks.text: Amines mein N-H signal broad (chaura) hota hai, lekin alcohols ke O-H signal se zyada broad nahi hota.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Gaariyon ke dhuen (vehicle emissions) mein pollutants (aaloodgi phailane wali cheezein) pehchanne ke liye infrared spectroscopy use hoti hai. Hawa ke sensors carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide aur unburnt (na-jale) hydrocarbons jaise pollutants ki amount (miqdar) detect aur measure karte hain. Aisa aam taur par motorways aur busy town centres (masroof shehri ilaqon) mein local (maqami) pollution par nazar rakhne ke liye kiya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Do infrared spectra, A (oopar) aur B (neeche), dono absorbance / % (oopar 0, neeche 100) aur wavenumber/cm^-1 (4000 se 500) par. A mein 3450 ke qareeb chhota dip (jhukao), 3000 ke qareeb strong band aur 1750 ke qareeb bohat strong, sharp (nokeela) band, phir 1500 se neeche kai bands. B mein 3350 ke qareeb bohat broad (chaura), deep (gehra) band, 2950 ke qareeb strong bands aur 1500 se neeche bohat se bands.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 29.2 (IR): infrared spectra A aur B (kitab yahan Example 29.1 wale spectra dobara chhapti hai; hamari drawing).

blocks.prompt: i) In do infrared spectra (A aur B) mein se kaun sa butanone ka hai aur kaun sa butan-2-ol ka?
blocks.explanation: Jis spectrum mein taqreeban 1700-1720 cm⁻¹ par sharp (nokeela), strong band ho aur 3200-3600 cm⁻¹ par broad (chaura) band na ho, woh butanone hai (spectrum A). Jis mein 3200-3600 cm⁻¹ par broad O-H band ho aur C=O band na ho, woh butan-2-ol hai (spectrum B).

blocks.alt: Do IR spectra, IR Spectra for Compound T (oopar) aur IR Spectra for Compound U (neeche), dono transmittance % (0 se 100) aur wavenumber/cm^-1 (4000 se taqreeban 400). T mein taqreeban 3500 se 2500 tak bohat broad dip, 3000 ke qareeb sab se gehra, 1780 ke qareeb bohat strong band aur 1600 se neeche bohat se bands. U ki baseline taqreeban 80 % par seedhi, 2950 ke qareeb chhote bands, 1740 ke qareeb bohat strong band aur 1450, 1370, 1240 aur 1050 ke qareeb strong bands.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 29.2 (IR): compounds T aur U ke IR spectra (Quick Check mein chhape spectra ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.prompt: ii) Compounds T aur U isomers hain aur dono ka molecular formula C₃H₆O₂ hai. Diye gaye spectra se in ke structures batayein.
blocks.explanation: T carboxylic acid hai (broad O-H 2500-3300 aur C=O): propanoic acid, CH₃CH₂COOH. U ester hai (C=O hai lekin O-H nahi): methyl ethanoate, CH₃COOCH₃, ya ethyl methanoate, HCOOCH₂CH₃. (Bands kitab ke spectra se parhe gaye.)

items: Alcohol: O-H 3200-3600 cm⁻¹ par broad; amine: N-H 3300 aur 3400 cm⁻¹ par do weak peaks.
Amide: N-H (do peaks) aur 1660 cm⁻¹ par C=O.
Carboxylic acid: 1700 cm⁻¹ par C=O aur 2500-3300 cm⁻¹ par bohat broad O-H.
